description_sq:
Apartament 1+1 ne Shitje ne Astir! 
Nuk shitet me kredi.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 6 te nje pallati te ri me ashensor prane bulevardit Migjeni te pasticeri Nela 6. Apartamenti ka nje planimetri te rregullt, siperfaqe totale prej 61 m2, organizohet ne hyrjen kryesore ne korridorin nga ku behet shperndarja ne sallonin e ndenjies se bashku me pjesen e gatimit, dhomen e gjumit me akses ne ballkon edhe tualetin i cili eshte me ndricim natyrale. Ideale per banime por edhe per investime. Zona ka akses te shpejt edhe ofron te gjitha facilitetet per nje jetese komode. Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor!
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Astir! Not sold on credit. The apartment is located on the 6th floor of a new building with an elevator near the Migjeni boulevard to the Nela pastry shop 6. The apartment has a regular layout, a total area of ​​61 m2, it is organized at the main entrance in the corridor from where the distribution is made in the living room together with the kitchen area, the bedroom with access to the balcony and the toilet which is with natural lighting. Ideal for residences but also for investments. The area has quick access and offers all the facilities for a comfortable life. Has regular mortgage documentation!
